bibl.title: Babatha's Orchard: The Yadin Papyri and an Ancient Jewish Family Tale Retold.
bibl.seg: Philip F. Esler, Babatha's Orchard: The Yadin Papyri and an Ancient Jewish Family Tale Retold.
Oxford, Oxford University Press, 2017, xviii-282 pp., figg. ISBN 978-0-19-876716-9. £52.
C.R. par Michael Owen Wise, Dead Sea Discoveries 26 (2019) pp. 104-106.
bibl.note: Prologue: Re-telling an ancient Jewish family tale. - 1. Archival ethnography. - 2. Nabatea and the Nabateans. - 3. Life in Maoza. - 4. Muqimu borrows money from his wife (94 CE). - 5. Archelaus purchases a date-palm orchard (99 CE). - 6. Archelaus rescinds his purchase. - 7. Shim‘on purchases a date-palm orchard (99 CE). - 8. P. Yadin II, 4: its character and parties. - 9. P. Yadin II, 4 and Shim‘on's purchase of the orchard. - 10. An ancient Jewish family tale. - Appendix 1. Emended Nabatean Aramaic text of P. Yadin II, 4 (with annotations); - Appendix 2. Translations of P. Yadin II, 1-4 (with annotations). - References. Author index. Subject index.
